desc:
Roughly ten years has passed since society collapsed at the hands of a parasitic fungal outbreak. Nature has stepped in to reclaim a desolate earth, with new perils—radiation, fungal spores, and their fellow man—that the remnants of civilization must now battle against.

— ⚠️ This is a freeform roleplay; there's no established factions, characters, or even lore that you have to abide by.
— 🏗️ This game is built with R6 in mind. If you find yourself out of place or unable to fit through most doors, scale down your avatars to make them more compatible with the environment. 
— ⏳ Remnants has a very large map with a lot of locations. Lag will be common for most players.

⭐Join the group for in-game benefits, such as the Backpack and Rides library!⭐

 ';chatlogs true'
